questions.questionText: How does AGI differ from the AI tools available today?
options: It is just a faster chatbot
AGI aims at broad, human-like general capability across tasks; today’s tools are narrow systems trained for particular tasks

questions.questionText: The safest first step when adopting AI in a small business is to:
options: Automate your entire operation at once
Pick one repetitive, low-risk task (like drafting quotes or summarising notes) and trial it with human review
Give the AI your banking passwords

questions.questionText: Before putting customer information into an AI tool you should:
options: Nothing — AI tools are always private
Check the tool’s data handling and your privacy obligations, and remove identifying details where possible
Ask the customer to do it

questions.questionText: AI-generated quotes, emails or content should be:
options: Reviewed by a person for accuracy and tone before they go out
